title: Don’t Let a Father’s Love Be Silent
synopsis: Why are some fathers rarely involved in their children’s upbringing?

fullText.simplified:
让父爱不再沉默

    人们常说父爱如山，高大深沉。父亲给予孩子博大深沉的爱，支持和鼓励孩子不断努力。来自父亲的爱是伟大的，但有时也是沉默的，因为父亲往往不会直接向孩子表现出疼爱。因此，许多人会在年轻的时候不理解父亲，甚至与父亲产生矛盾。而等到逐渐能理解父亲的时候，父亲已经衰老或是去世了。
    这时候，人们通过回忆往事，总是能够清楚地找出问题背后的原因：一是男性花在工作上的时间更多，分配给家庭的时间相对较少；二是男性受困于角色传统，不擅长直白的情感表达。
    当人们找出这些原因后，大家开始理解父亲，当代社会也正致力于解决这些问题。
    近几年，中国社会各界开始讨论延长男性员工陪产假，以解决“丧偶式育儿”这一问题。丧偶式育儿是指父母中的一方很少参与孩子的养育，通常缺席的一方是父亲。出现这种现象的原因，不排除有些父亲主观上不想参与，但对大部分投身于工作无暇分身的父亲来说则是无奈之举。父亲需要时间长一点儿的陪产假，中国的陪产假制度有待完善，近几年政府已经开始关注这一问题。
    另一方面，愿意直接表达情感的男性也越来越多，父亲参与育儿也慢慢成为一种社会潮流。例如，前几年就开始流行爸爸带孩子去旅行的综艺节目，爸爸和孩子们在旅行中放松自我，亲子关系变得更亲密。每年的8月8日也逐渐成为了第二个父亲节，人们称之为“爸爸节”。这一天，父亲们会陪自己的孩子玩耍，亲子双方都喜欢这样的形式。
    时代在改变，从前父亲把后背留给孩子，如今孩子们更热爱父亲的怀抱，父爱开始不再沉默。
fullText.traditional:
讓父愛不再沉默

    人們常說父愛如山，高大深沉。父親給予孩子博大深沉的愛，支持和鼓勵孩子不斷努力。來自父親的愛是偉大的，但有時也是沉默的，因為父親往往不會直接向孩子表現出疼愛。因此，許多人會在年輕的時候不理解父親，甚至與父親產生矛盾。而等到逐漸能理解父親的時候，父親已經衰老或是去世了。
    這時候，人們通過回憶往事，總是能夠清楚地找出問題背後的原因：一是男性花在工作上的時間更多，分配給家庭的時間相對較少；二是男性受困於角色傳統，不擅長直白的情感表達。
    當人們找出這些原因後，大家開始理解父親，當代社會也正致力於解決這些問題。
    近幾年，中國社會各界開始討論延長男性員工陪產假，以解決“喪偶式育兒”這一問題。喪偶式育兒是指父母中的一方很少參與孩子的養育，通常缺席的一方是父親。出現這種現象的原因，不排除有些父親主觀上不想參與，但對大部分投身於工作無暇分身的父親來說則是無奈之舉。父親需要時間長一點兒的陪產假，中國的陪產假制度有待完善，近幾年政府已經開始關注這一問題。
    另一方面，願意直接表達情感的男性也越來越多，父親參與育兒也慢慢成為一種社會潮流。例如，前幾年就開始流行爸爸帶孩子去旅行的綜藝節目，爸爸和孩子們在旅行中放鬆自我，親子關係變得更親密。每年的8月8日也逐漸成為了第二個父親節，人們稱之為“爸爸節”。這一天，父親們會陪自己的孩子玩耍，親子雙方都喜歡這樣的形式。
    時代在改變，從前父親把後背留給孩子，如今孩子們更熱愛父親的懷抱，父愛開始不再沉默。

sentences.simplified: 来自父亲的爱是伟大的，但有时也是沉默的，

sentences.simplified: 因为父亲往往不会直接向孩子表现出疼爱。
sentences.traditional: 因為父親往往不會直接向孩子表現出疼愛。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi fù qīn wǎng wǎng bú huì zhí jiē xiàng hái zi biǎo xiàn chū téng ài
sentences.english: The love from a father is great, but sometimes it is silent, ..

sentences.traditional: 因此，許多人會在年輕的時候不理解父親，甚至與父親產生矛盾。

sentences.english: .. as fathers often do not directly express their affection towards their children.

sentences.simplified: 而等到逐渐能理解父亲的时候，父亲已经衰老或是去世了。
sentences.traditional: 而等到逐漸能理解父親的時候，父親已經衰老或是去世了。
sentences.pinyin: ér děng dào zhú jiàn néng lǐ jiě fù qīn de shí hou fù qīn yǐ jīng shuāi lǎo huò shì qù shì le
sentences.english: As a result, many people don’t understand their fathers or even have conflicts with them when they are young.
And by the time they could gradually understand their father, he would have already aged or passed away.

sentences.english: At this time, people can always clearly identify the reasons behind the problems by recalling past events.

sentences.traditional: 二是男性受困於角色傳統，不擅長直白的情感表達。

sentences.english: First, men spend more time at work and allocate relatively less time to their families.
Second, men are trapped by traditional roles and are not good at directly expressing their emotions.

sentences.traditional: 當人們找出這些原因後，大家開始理解父親，

sentences.traditional: 當代社會也正致力於解決這些問題。

sentences.english: Once people have figured out these reasons, they begin to understand fathers.
Contemporary society is working to address these issues.

sentences.traditional: 以解決“喪偶式育兒”這一問題。

sentences.english: In recent years, all sectors of Chinese society have started to discuss extending paternity leave for male employees ..

sentences.simplified: 丧偶式育儿是指父母中的一方很少参与孩子的养育，
sentences.traditional: 喪偶式育兒是指父母中的一方很少參與孩子的養育，
sentences.pinyin: sàng ǒu shì yù ér shì zhǐ fù mǔ zhōng de yì fāng hěn shǎo cān yù hái zi de yǎng yù
sentences.english: .. to address the problem of “widowed parenting”.

sentences.simplified: 通常缺席的一方是父亲。
sentences.traditional: 通常缺席的一方是父親。
sentences.pinyin: tōng cháng quē xí de yì fāng shì fù qīn
sentences.english: Widowed parenting is when one parent is rarely involved in the child’s upbringing.

sentences.simplified: 出现这种现象的原因，不排除有些父亲主观上不想参与，
sentences.traditional: 出現這種現象的原因，不排除有些父親主觀上不想參與，
sentences.pinyin: chū xiàn zhè zhǒng xiàn xiàng de yuán yīn bù pái chú yǒu xiē fù qīn zhǔ guān shang bù xiǎng cān yù
sentences.english: Usually, the absent parent is the father.

sentences.simplified: 但对大部分投身于工作无暇分身的父亲来说则是无奈之举。
sentences.traditional: 但對大部分投身於工作無暇分身的父親來說則是無奈之舉。
sentences.pinyin: dàn duì dà bù fen tóu shēn yú gōng zuò wú xiá fēn shēn de fù qīn lái shuō zé shì wú nài zhī jǔ
sentences.english: The reason for this phenomenon could be that some fathers simply do not want to be involved.

sentences.simplified: 父亲需要时间长一点儿的陪产假，中国的陪产假制度有待完善，
sentences.traditional: 父親需要時間長一點兒的陪產假，中國的陪產假制度有待完善，
sentences.pinyin: fù qīn xū yào shí jiān cháng yì diǎn'r de péi chǎn jià zhōng guó de péi chǎn jià zhì dù yǒu dài wán shàn
sentences.english: But the majority of fathers who are occupied with work and have no leisure time have no choice.

sentences.simplified: 近几年政府已经开始关注这一问题。
sentences.traditional: 近幾年政府已經開始關注這一問題。
sentences.pinyin: jìn jǐ nián zhèng fǔ yǐ jīng kāi shǐ guān zhù zhè yī wèn tí
sentences.english: Fathers need longer paternity leave, and China’s paternity leave system needs to be improved.
The government has begun to focus on this issue in recent years.

sentences.simplified: 另一方面，愿意直接表达情感的男性也越来越多，
sentences.traditional: 另一方面，願意直接表達情感的男性也越來越多，
sentences.pinyin: lìng yī fāng miàn yuàn yì zhí jiē biǎo dá qíng gǎn de nán xìng yě yuè lái yuè duō

sentences.simplified: 父亲参与育儿也慢慢成为一种社会潮流。
sentences.traditional: 父親參與育兒也慢慢成為一種社會潮流。
sentences.pinyin: fù qīn cān yù yù ér yě màn man chéng wéi yì zhǒng shè huì cháo liú
sentences.english: On the other hand, a growing number of men are willing to express their emotions directly, ..

sentences.simplified: 例如，前几年就开始流行爸爸带孩子去旅行的综艺节目，
sentences.traditional: 例如，前幾年就開始流行爸爸帶孩子去旅行的綜藝節目，
sentences.pinyin: lì rú qián jǐ nián jiù kāi shǐ liú xíng bà ba dài hái zi qù lǚ xíng de zōng yì jié mù
sentences.english: .. and it is slowly becoming a social trend for fathers to be involved in parenting.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸和孩子们在旅行中放松自我，亲子关系变得更亲密。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸和孩子們在旅行中放鬆自我，親子關係變得更親密。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba hé hái zi men zài lǚ xíng zhōng fàng sōng zì wǒ qīn zǐ guān xi biàn de gèng qīn mì
sentences.english: For example, in recent years, there has been a popular trend of reality TV shows where fathers take their children on trips.

sentences.simplified: 每年的8月8日也逐渐成为了第二个父亲节，人们称之为“爸爸节”。
sentences.traditional: 每年的8月8日也逐漸成為了第二個父親節，人們稱之為“爸爸節”。
sentences.pinyin: měi nián de 1 yuè 1 rì yě zhú jiàn chéng wèi le dì èr ge fù qīn jié rén men chēng zhī wéi bà ba jié
sentences.english: During these trips, fathers and their children can unwind and let loose, leading to a closer parent-child relationship.

sentences.simplified: 这一天，父亲们会陪自己的孩子玩耍，亲子双方都喜欢这样的形式。
sentences.traditional: 這一天，父親們會陪自己的孩子玩耍，親子雙方都喜歡這樣的形式。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì tiān fù qīn men huì péi zì jǐ de hái zi wán shuǎ qīn zǐ shuāng fāng dōu xǐ huan zhè yàng de xíng shì
sentences.english: August 8th each year has gradually become a second Father’s Day, and it is referred to as “Dad’s Day” by people.
On this day, fathers will play with their children, and both fathers and children enjoy this interaction.

sentences.simplified: 时代在改变，从前父亲把后背留给孩子，如今孩子们更热爱父亲的怀抱，
sentences.traditional: 時代在改變，從前父親把後背留給孩子，如今孩子們更熱愛父親的懷抱，
sentences.pinyin: shí dài zài gǎi biàn cóng qián fù qīn bǎ hòu bèi liú gěi hái zi rú jīn hái zi men gèng rè ài fù qīn de huái bào

sentences.simplified: 父爱开始不再沉默。
sentences.traditional: 父愛開始不再沉默。
sentences.pinyin: fù ài kāi shǐ bú zài chén mò
sentences.english: Times are changing. In the past, fathers gave their backs to their children, but now children prefer their father’s embrace.

sentence_translations: Don’t Let a Father’s Love Be Silent
People often say that a father’s love is like a mountain, high and deep.
Fathers give their children boundless and deep love, supporting them and encouraging them to keep trying.
The love from a father is great, but sometimes it is silent, ..
.. as fathers often do not directly express their affection towards their children.
As a result, many people don’t understand their fathers or even have conflicts with them when they are young.
And by the time they could gradually understand their father, he would have already aged or passed away.
At this time, people can always clearly identify the reasons behind the problems by recalling past events.
First, men spend more time at work and allocate relatively less time to their families.
Second, men are trapped by traditional roles and are not good at directly expressing their emotions.
Once people have figured out these reasons, they begin to understand fathers.
Contemporary society is working to address these issues.
In recent years, all sectors of Chinese society have started to discuss extending paternity leave for male employees ..
.. to address the problem of “widowed parenting”.
Widowed parenting is when one parent is rarely involved in the child’s upbringing.
Usually, the absent parent is the father.
The reason for this phenomenon could be that some fathers simply do not want to be involved.
But the majority of fathers who are occupied with work and have no leisure time have no choice.
Fathers need longer paternity leave, and China’s paternity leave system needs to be improved.
The government has begun to focus on this issue in recent years.
On the other hand, a growing number of men are willing to express their emotions directly, ..
.. and it is slowly becoming a social trend for fathers to be involved in parenting.
For example, in recent years, there has been a popular trend of reality TV shows where fathers take their children on trips.
During these trips, fathers and their children can unwind and let loose, leading to a closer parent-child relationship.
August 8th each year has gradually become a second Father’s Day, and it is referred to as “Dad’s Day” by people.
On this day, fathers will play with their children, and both fathers and children enjoy this interaction.
Times are changing. In the past, fathers gave their backs to their children, but now children prefer their father’s embrace.
A father’s love is beginning to be no longer silent.
